race.description: Nathan Hobson Trainer Of The Year25/26 (Bm56) Hcp
race.comment: MOTIVER (10) was in the money two starts back at Geelong but couldn't back it up last time when sixth over 3172m at Warrnambool. Forget that and go off the Geelong performance, which is good enough to test these. Blinkers on could be significant. WIMMERA STAR (4) has been in the mix since scoring at Horsham on April 27, the latest offering a second over 2050m at Mt Gambier. Unplaced at his only previous try at the trip but another big run is likely in this company. VERIFIER (7) has been costly and there has to be question marks over his will to win but he's fit and good enough to put himself there at the finish. WOLFOFFITROYSTREET (2) has been a costly commodity but got the maiden out of the way last start when up to 2200m, which he will be better for. FONN POWER (3) was safely held when second last time out over 2000m at Mildura, beaten 3.5 lengths, after a win at Murtoa at the previous outing. Expect a better run this time.
